name: Eq-bench
intro: EQ-Bench论文描述的是60题英文V1情绪理解基准：模型阅读GPT-4生成的冲突或紧张对话，为四种候选情绪给出0–10强度，逐步批评后修订，再按与作者归一化参考分布的绝对距离计分。当前官方仓库默认171题V2；复现论文流程必须显式选择V1与修订模式。
build_method: GPT-4生成200段冲突/紧张对话并为V1选取60段, 作者制定四情绪参考强度, 精确零样本批评-修订提示, 自动解析与归一化距离计分
metric: EQ-Bench V1分数（允许负分；随机基线0；精确参考上限100）
task_type: 情绪理解与人际动态推理
eval_feature: 论文V1的四情绪评分与批评-修订, 相对强度归一化, 首轮/修订整轮择优, 少于50/60可解析即失败
scale: 论文V1：60个英文问题（后续官方README称从200段生成对话中选取）
build_method_en: GPT-4 generation of 200 conflict/tension dialogues and selection of 60 for V1, author-defined four-emotion references, exact zero-shot critique/revision prompting, automatic parsing and normalized distance scoring
eval_feature_en: Paper V1 four-emotion critique/revision, relative-intensity normalization, whole-run first/revised selection, failure below 50/60 parseable answers
intro_en: The EQ-Bench paper specifies the 60-item English V1 emotional-understanding benchmark: models read GPT-4-generated conflict or tension dialogues, rate four emotions from 0 to 10, critique and revise those ratings, and are scored by absolute distance from author-normalized references. The current official repository defaults to 171-item V2; reproducing the paper requires explicit V1 plus revision selection.
scale_en: Paper V1: 60 English questions (selected from 200 generated dialogues according to the later official README)
metric_en: EQ-Bench V1 Score (negative possible; random baseline 0; exact-reference ceiling 100)

drawio_review_note: Evidence is frozen to arXiv:2312.06281v2 (PDF SHA-256 68a0d6636a79939218562607a4793acc760e9c942dc88ad3a321fa41d11e7860), official main_v2_4 repo commit 337df8abdb8f71dfd3bdcc2cc361d40e3cbb245a, and data/eq_bench_v1_questions_60.json (SHA-256 9c52ae21deab827bfc77ac7dacb3b1b7e506b83752441c85aec9903671eac9de). Paper Sections 2.6 and 3.1–3.10 support random location/author-style/scenario seeds, GPT-4 conflict/tension dialogues, author-defined questions/four emotions/reference intensities, exact zero-shot first-pass/critique/revised headings, normalization to sum 10, q = 10 − Σ absolute differences, separate parseable first/revised averages, whole-run rather than per-item selection, 10× scaling, random baseline 0, exact-match ceiling 100, and failure below 50/60 parseables. V1 has no lower score clamp: negative scores are possible, while 0 is the random-response baseline rather than the lower bound. Paper Section 3.10 starts inference at temperature 0.01, adds 0.15 after each parse failure, and continues until a parseable answer is produced or the number of attempts exceeds 5. The later official README supplies the 200-generated / 60-selected coherent-and-challenging V1 pool fact but no item-level selection rubric. At the pinned commit the repository defaults to V2 (171 items, full-scale scoring, revision off), so paper-compatible invocation is -v1 -revise and V1/V2 scores are not comparable. The pinned runner instead caps each question at three attempts, despite using the same 0.01 start and +0.15 increment; that paper-versus-runner divergence is shown separately. Current aggregation also adds a release-only 95% revised-parseability guard, which is shown separately from the paper rule.
